title: REQ · Typed focusChange and menuClose events exist on the Phaser to React bus
description: Context: events.ts declares objectHover, objectClick, characterClick and sceneReady. Keyboard handling needs two more typed events. Desired: focusChange carries the focused object id or null, and menuClose carries no data. Why: typed events are required between Phaser and React.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bus, when focusChange is emitted with {id:'bookshelf'}, then a subscribed handler receives that payload.
Given the bus, when menuClose is emitted, then a subscribed handler is called once.
definition_of_done: Interface compiles with tsc and the events are usable by emit/on
